title: Arranging a meeting
text: Hi Sara, it's Tom. Are you available on Thursday? I'd like to arrange a meeting to talk about the trip. — Hi Tom. Thursday is difficult. My schedule is really busy, and I have a dentist appointment at four. Can we meet on Friday instead? — Friday works for me. What time? — How about ten? I need to leave at twelve to pick up my son from school. — Ten is perfect. I'll book a room that has a projector. — Great. Could you remind me the day before? I always forget things. — Of course. I'll send you a message on Thursday evening. And I promise the meeting won't take more than an hour. — Oh, and one more thing. Could you bring the price list from the hotel? I think we need to decide which hotel to choose before the end of the month. — Sure. Actually, I've already compared two of them. The one that is near the beach is more expensive, but it's probably more comfortable for the children. — OK, let's look at both on Friday and decide together. — Thanks, Tom. See you on Friday.

qs.q: Why can't Sara meet on Thursday?
opts: She is busy and has an appointment.
qs.exp: Busy schedule + dentist appointment at four.
qs.ru: Плотный график и приём у стоматолога.

qs.exp: “Friday works for me… How about ten?”

qs.q: Sara needs to leave at twelve to pick up her son.
qs.exp: “I need to leave at twelve to pick up my son”.

qs.q: What kind of room will Tom book?
opts: a room that has a projector

qs.q: What will Tom do on Thursday evening?
qs.exp: He will send her a message to remind her.

qs.q: The hotel near the beach is cheaper.
qs.exp: “The one that is near the beach is more expensive”.
